summary: Implemented location-based manifest membership check in check-architecture.ts. Created a pure function architectureUndeclaredModules() that checks every source file under orchestrator/src and hub/src against the manifest, using a shrink-only baseline for currently undeclared files. The check reports the count of undeclared files and passes with the current baseline of 538 files.

change_guide.verify: Check that the baseline contains all currently undeclared files under orchestrator/src and hub/src
